s5.title: 1796 RoboTigers | Behind the Bumpers | FRC CRESCENDO Robot

bet.text: A back pass-through: every note goes to the elevator in the middle, which sends it to the amp or trap, or on to the shooter.

demand.text: The team designs and practices around playing through any defense, because its matches are more likely than not to be defended.

auto.text: A camera at the top of the elevator looks for notes, and the robot takes another path to the center line if a target note is gone.

cycle.text: The under-bumper intake centers a note and passes it to the elevator's rollers. From there it is spat out at the amp, or passed through to the shooter, whose pivot is set from the distance to the speaker.

endgame.text: The climb goes up and a sequence leads to the trap: wheels roll on the stage so that the mechanism enters the flap door and drops the note in.

changed.text: It had only front and back AprilTag cameras for a while. Pose was inconsistent when robots or defense blocked one, so cameras were added on both sides. This was the team's first year without a welded frame; bends in playoffs had affected the frame and the intake.

outcome.text: 49-9-0 in official play; ranked 5 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 57.65, Johnson).

solves.text: Replace bent parts easily during competitions

facts.text: Krakens for both drive and steering
The elevator, climb and shooter sit on one plate, so frames can be switched more easily

solves.text: Take notes from nearly the full frame width and center them

facts.text: Rollers below and a gripped aluminum bar above pull the note in and center it
3D printed wedges center notes from the side or the middle
An offset plate keeps pulleys away from the note, which leaves the intake slightly short of full width
Parts the student calls bananas stop the bars bending and the belts losing tension

solves.text: Reach the amp and trap and leave the back open for the pass-through

facts.text: Belts run inside the tubing
One Kraken drives both sides at 1:1
Belt clamps are printed with carbon fiber so that belts hold tension

solves.text: Score the amp and trap with one mechanism

facts.text: Three rollers on the carriage set the spit-out angle for both
Wheels on it roll along the stage to enter the trap's flap door

solves.text: Shoot straight and accurately into the speaker

facts.text: Two Krakens run two sets of wheels at different speeds to spin the note
Feeder wheels accelerate the note, or send it back to the amp and trap rollers
Maximum pivot angle, about
The pivot's custom belt box uses water-jet and 3D printed pulleys

solves.text: Lift the robot for the trap sequence

cost.text: Thick bearing plates were needed for the axle and were pocketed because weight was a concern

facts.text: The belt runs through the tube and is held by toothed clamp plates
One motor on each side
Bearings in each bearing block, about
A magnetic sensor zeroes it while the robot is disabled

functions.name: Vision

solves.text: Keep at least two tags in view when defended

functions.type: four AprilTag cameras and one note camera

facts.text: Limelights on the robot
One AprilTag camera on each side of the robot gives odometry, and distance to the speaker sets the shooter pivot
The fifth points down from the top of the elevator to detect notes
The two side cameras were added to catch the stage and amp AprilTags
The students report that the side cameras improved pose accuracy a lot

decisions.choice: Rig the elevator inside its tubes
decisions.because: a back pass-through to the shooter ruled out the rigging on the back that the team always used
parts bent in competition are much easier to replace
decisions.instead_of: a welded frame, as in earlier years

decisions.because: pose was inconsistent when other robots or defense blocked one camera, results were poor when the team simulated that, and it wanted always to see at least two tags
chain has slack, and the shooter needed accuracy
it shoots straighter and more accurately
